title: City Council District 2
statement: As we move forward with the Baylight District project, I emphasize the importance of addressing the economic imbalance in Downtown Oakland. The recent data shows a decline in sentiment and an increase in crime, which necessitates targeted support. I propose we allocate resources to enhance public safety and stimulate local businesses, ensuring the success of the Baylight District benefits the entire community, including Jack London and Chinatown.
